name: Semibreve
description: Whole notes: a bare open oval, no stem, held for the length of the bar.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10%; top: 26%; width: 80%; height: 48%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 52%, #000 52%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 52%, #000 52%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(-18deg, 0deg, 18deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(-18deg, 0deg, 18deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
